title: PreToolUse Hook Input
description: JSON piped to stdin for PreToolUse hooks (Write, Edit). Derived from enforce-spec.sh field access patterns.

tool_name.description: Name of the tool being invoked (e.g., Write, Edit, Bash)

file_path.description: Absolute or relative path of the file being written/edited. Parsed by enforce-spec.sh via python3 json.load.

content.description: File content (Write) or replacement text (Edit). Not parsed by hooks.
